description: Walkable spatial studies of cellular fields.

cellular_space.name: Cellular Space
cellular_space.description: Two real walkable enclosures. form=womb is a curved cavity moulded by 3D feature distances. form=commons is a 3D Voronoi partition with arched passages and six omitted walls joining four central cells. Mesh collision matches the visible boundary. Surface shading samples a separate 3D cellular field.
interactions: Pass through cell walls at the arches
Find the four floor centres sharing the large middle room
cellular_space.qfep_connection: A nearest-site boundary need not remain a barrier. The central sites keep their identities while their shared walls are omitted, allowing a common interior.
